This is an observational microbiome multi-omics study of familial type 1 diabetes, not an oncology or treatment response study. Many schema fields are designed for cancer treatment studies and are not applicable to this study design.
The paper reports on 20 individuals from 4 families with T1DM and healthy controls, but does not report individual-level clinical data suitable for sample-level extraction.
Biomarker information is reported at the community/functional level (metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics) rather than as individual clinical biomarkers with standard clinical units.
Study duration was 2-4 months with 3 visits, but disease response measures (ORR, PFS, OS, RECIST) are not relevant to this observational microbiome study.
